# Nawa Guard

> Open-source, self-hosted, accessible puzzle CAPTCHA. A privacy-friendly alternative to reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha and Cloudflare Turnstile. Your server issues challenges and verifies pass tokens; nothing is sent to a third party.

- Source: https://github.com/oriebalzyuot96/nawa-guard
- License: MIT

## Packages
- @nawa-guard/server: Node.js (≥18) challenge engine, verification, single-use pass tokens, Express middleware (`nawaGuardExpress`, `requireCaptcha`). Zero runtime dependencies.
- @nawa-guard/widget: `<nawa-guard>` Web Component (keyboard, touch, screen-reader alternative, Arabic/English, RTL, themes).
- @nawa-guard/react, @nawa-guard/vue, @nawa-guard/svelte, @nawa-guard/angular: framework wrappers.
- NawaGuard.AspNetCore (NuGet): `AddNawaGuard()`, `[RequireNawaGuard]`, `.RequireNawaGuard()` to verify pass tokens in ASP.NET Core.

## Challenge types
Slider jigsaw, rotate to upright, select matching icons, math image, drag to order, connect the dots, invisible proof-of-work, accessible text question.

## Security model
Answers sealed with AES-256-GCM inside the challenge token; HMAC-signed, short-lived, single-use pass tokens; expiry, IP/UA binding, key rotation, replay store (memory or Redis), pointer-trajectory heuristics, rate-limit hooks.
